concepts.definition: F11 is the source's foundation-to-law account for change entry, classification and reuse, ambiguity governance, and shared-interface migration. Its additional instance premises are changing specifications during work, heterogeneous reports entering one product, shared interfaces with multiple producers and consumers, and decisions governed by policy or reserved human authority. The source calls P0 recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 independent; P4b derived from P0 and P2 under non-reacquirability of step-produced facts; and P5 derived from P0 and P6 under an open-world premise. These are assertions about the subject's foundations.

grounding.quote: Its instance premises, which the commitments do not supply, are

concepts.label: Foundation-to-law change and ambiguity family

concepts.definition: The common entry operation for substantive reports, including bugs, feature requests, issues, regressions, operator findings, release blockers and scenario failures. It determines substantiveness, product boundary and scope, lawful class, constitutional re-entry point, affected downstream surfaces and evidence requiring repricing/rederivation/reproof, and release-scope retention or repricing. Its evidence selection is S_Δ over impact cover I(Δ). Diagnosis distinguishes defective realisation, inadequate requirement or design, inaccurate predictive model, and insufficient observation.

grounding.quote: There is one front door for substantive change.

concepts.label: Universal intake triage

concepts.definition: Minimum declared change states with re-entry and downstream flow: goal_reprice changes bounded work-wave focus, enters Goals, and flows through Intent, Product, Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence where deeper constitutional truth changes; intent_reprice changes direction or scope, enters Intent, and flows through Product, Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence; product_reprice changes current product realisation while intent stays stable, enters Product, and flows through Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence; requirement_reprice changes constitutional truth while direction stays stable, enters Requirements, and flows through Design, Code and Evidence; design_reframe changes realisation structure while active intent and requirement truth stay stable, enters Design, and flows through Code and Evidence; realization_refactor changes local code, configuration or attributes without intended constitutional or structural change, enters only the realised surface, and flows nowhere upstream.

grounding.quote: The minimum lawful change classes, each with its re-entry point and the

concepts.label: Declared change classes

concepts.definition: One reusable intake classification, annotated C for reproducible facts and declared-rule application, J for residual semantic or materiality judgment, and O for rulings reserved to their actual owner. Its ordered components are authority traversal, public delta, accepted-design coverage and rule-determined treatment. Relation states changed/unchanged/unknown, identity additions/removals/retained changed values, and coverage states covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside-scope are computed facts, not evaluation results.

grounding.quote:
C denotes reproducible facts and declared rule
application; J denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; O denotes
a ruling reserved to its actual owner.

concepts.label: Computed classification with C, J and O

concepts.definition: A change-span gate applying the closure condition owned by TICKETS §7 to declared obligations, using recorded evidence and results. It checks upstream sufficiency, downstream consistency with active upstream truth, and proof of active intended behaviour.

grounding.quote:
No gate closes while the affected active surfaces are internally
inconsistent

concepts.label: Consistency gate

concepts.definition: SPEC_METHOD's sprint is a bounded execution-control surface under existing constitutional authority. It batches work, coordinates tickets or iteration entries, prices proof cost and forces close review. Deferred local compliance is escrow, while sprint close is forensic reconciliation rather than automatic approval.

grounding.quote:
A sprint is a bounded execution-control surface, not a new layer in the
constitutional chain

concepts.label: Sprint execution boundary

concepts.definition: Lifetime-based carrier selection: a durable ticket for identity across sessions, a sprint-local entry for traceability valuable only inside a batch, or a run/return record for work confined to one activation. TICKETS §1 owns the model and §5 the smallest-lawful-carrier selection.

grounding.quote: The carrier of a work item is selected for its required lifetime:

concepts.label: Work carrier selection

concepts.definition: Four source-defined procedures: substantive intake; feature introduction/change; project bootstrap or requirement-surface repricing; and response to a real-use-case gap. They describe constitutional re-entry, forward derivation, design/implementation coordination, ambiguity recording and evidence production, without instantiating these operations here.

grounding.quote: When any substantive intake arrives

concepts.label: Method procedures

concepts.definition: Substrate-neutral bounded context urn:stdo:bounded-context:ambiguity-governance under the selected complete basis. Goals narrow priority/work wave; intent direction/scope; product realisation shape/terms; requirements constitutional obligation; tenant or stack binding executable realisation class; design structural interpretation; implementation local detail. Major ambiguity materially affects architecture, stack, product boundary, execution/deployment admissibility, public contracts or downstream law; micro ambiguity is local choice within governed design.

grounding.quote: This member owns the substrate-neutral ambiguity-governance bounded context

concepts.label: Ambiguity governance

concepts.definition: Lawful probabilistic processing, urn:stdo:concept:ambiguity-governance:lawful-probabilistic-processing, is bounded non-human processing permitted by declared policy to carry or resolve declared ambiguity. Human adjudication, urn:stdo:concept:ambiguity-governance:human-adjudication, is explicit human judgment admitted by authority to resolve ambiguity where policy or risk appetite requires it. Operation kind depends on admission and required authority, not merely the presence of a person.

grounding.quote:
That admission makes an operation
human adjudication.

concepts.label: Probabilistic processing and human adjudication

concepts.definition: Recursive product lineage distinguishes substrate, development product, source project, release cut, product, install, artifact and product definition. A released product may build its successor, a dependent product or downstream artifacts. The product definition is the source project's present-tense surface, distinct from released artifact and builder. Immutable v<version>-rc.<n> identifies an exact point-in-time accepted-feature release cut; mutable v<version> discovers the highest-ordinal published immutable cut.

grounding.quote:
The only exact operative release identifier is the immutable release-cut
tag `v<version>-rc.<n>`

concepts.label: Lineage and release identities

concepts.definition: An authority-causality chain for reusable method changes: incident/review evidence → shared-method intake → one owning standard → consistency and independent review → human-authority acceptance → one complete released STDO version → explicit consumer selection → consumer-owned realisation and evidence. The chain does not prescribe intake workflow or artifact set.

grounding.quote:
The chain states authority causality. It prescribes no intake workflow and
no artifact set

concepts.label: Shared method adoption and propagation

concepts.definition: A constitutional migration for changes to load-bearing shared contracts, carriers, resolvers, providers, projection laws, closure laws or other interfaces on which multiple surfaces depend. It replaces authoritative core truth across producers, consumers and downstream effects; partial architecture split is not completion.

grounding.quote: Core interface changes are not ordinary local patches.

concepts.label: Core interface migration

concepts.definition: Two lawful constitutional strategies: inside-out hard-break replacement on the same implementation line, proceeding from source carrier outward; and fundamental re-adoption for an intentional major rederivation on materially different runtime, carrier, type-system, substrate or realisation-tree basis, with prior implementation held sideways as reference. Bounded evolution is a rebuttable selection presumption, not a third strategy.

grounding.quote:
Core interface and major implementation replacement work has two lawful
constitutional strategies

concepts.label: Constitutional migration strategies

concepts.definition: An outcome's acceptance path is its full causal closure: every admitted entrypoint, producer, consumer, resolver, fallback, shared state surface, event, projection and proof surface capable of changing, interpreting or closing it. Singular authority covers this closure rather than one successful trace. Intermediate product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are distinct claims.

grounding.quote:
For this rule the affected acceptance path is the full causal closure of
the outcome:

concepts.label: Product-slice acceptance path

concepts.definition: Any shared contract or carrier materially governing runtime closure, reporting/status truth, topology/frame progression, proof/qualification outcome, event/projection semantics, identity/binding resolution or provider/resolver behaviour. A change capable of altering how multiple surfaces decide current truth is a core-interface change.

grounding.quote: A core interface is any shared contract or carrier that materially governs

concepts.label: Core interface

concepts.definition: The explicit migration declaration and inventory, including old-path states remove, replace, re-authorize and temporary scaffolding.

grounding.quote:
Every old path is then classified as `remove`,
`replace`, `re-authorize` or `temporary scaffolding`.

concepts.label: Required migration protocol

concepts.definition: Compatibility aliases, fallback identity laws, bridge paths, old readers/writers and proxy or partial interfaces can preserve superseded authority. An explicit live-product compatibility feature is distinguished from current native truth.

grounding.quote:
The only lawful exception is an explicit compatibility
feature retained as part of the live product

concepts.label: Bridge paths and compatibility features

concepts.definition: Migration projections, reports, status views and topology views are downstream reflections of authoritative carriers, without a second closure authority.

grounding.quote:
Projections, reports, status views and topology views may reflect the
authoritative carrier; they do not become a second closure surface

concepts.label: Migration projections

concepts.definition: Inside-out migration ordering from the new authoritative source carrier to downstream read models, with explicit ticket dependencies and an initially discovered best-guess interface family.

grounding.quote:
Inside-out hard-break migrations proceed from the new authoritative source
carrier outward

concepts.label: Inside-out first sequencing

concepts.definition: A migration wave is an ordered set of deliberate hard breaks over one interface family, not a mode licensing ambiguous or competing authority.

grounding.quote: The migration wave is the ordered set of those breaks;

concepts.label: Hard-break sequence

concepts.definition: Three distinct proof scopes: per-break rejection/fail-closed proof; bounded intermediate product-slice proof; and complete migration-closure proof after the migration wave.

grounding.quote:
Bounded product-slice
proof may establish only the exact intermediate outcome permitted by the
path-relative promotion rule

concepts.label: Migration proof scopes

concepts.definition: Completion across the declared affected migration scope, distinct from accepted intermediate slices. Retention is a justification relation for a superseded mechanism serving a distinct currently supported responsibility.

grounding.quote: Retention bears the burden.

concepts.label: Migration closure and retention

concepts.definition: A constitutional reset on a new branch, version line or methodology basis. Prior constitutional documents become source material; prior design/code may be references. Constitutional adoption states are adopted, superseded, deferred and orphaned. Implementation states are carry_across (materially same, explicitly re-adopted), redundant (unneeded), and rewrite (needed but rebuilt under new requirements/design). These adoption states differ from live requirement standing and from RELEASE §9 predecessor-claim dispositions.

grounding.quote: fundamental migration is controlled adoption, not passive preservation.

concepts.label: Fundamental migration and adoption states

concepts.definition: Refactor and migration are described as a transformation wave over mutable implementation surfaces, with restricted temporary mixed state while in flight and one current operative surface across the affected scope when landed.

grounding.quote:
Refactor and migration should be understood as a transformation wave over
mutable
implementation surfaces

concepts.label: Transformation wave

concepts.definition: Source-defined application of ACTIVATION's step to agentic/probabilistic construction: accepted basis, bounded affected relations, selected computational relations, delegated execution/decision authority, construction/self-review, independent live-surface assessment where required, owner disposition, accepted checkpoint and next already-authorised action. Candidate availability, assessment and accept/local_repair/re_enter/reject disposition are separate results. Preservation, progress and completion are separate construction claims. Tenant binding supplies execution means and resource limits; configuration selects frames and return consumer.

grounding.quote:
a candidate that is available or
assessed is not thereby accepted

concepts.label: Bounded execution

concepts.definition: Evidence for constitutional realisation claims: authority trace, realisation proof, negative proof where drift is plausible, and present-tense residual open pressure. Proof identity/adequacy, semantic/evidence/projection separation and assurance congruence/qualification belong to EVALUATION; verification layers, testing taxonomy, fixture/proof portability, test authority, scenario bundles, installed proof and significant-path coverage belong to ASSURANCE.

grounding.quote:
includes an authority trace, realisation proof, negative proof
where drift is plausible, and a present-tense statement of the residual
open pressure

concepts.label: Realisation evidence

concepts.definition: An ADR records a design decision boundary: the choice making acceptance criteria true. Its fields are Status (active/superseded/retired), Implements requirement identifiers, Derives from intent identifier or strategy, Supersedes prior ADR/doctrine, Superseded by successor when superseded, and Retained special case when earlier behaviour is intentionally retained. ADR files are constitutional sources; an optional REGISTRY.md is a potentially drifting read model.

grounding.quote: ADRs are written per decision boundary, not per requirement file;

concepts.label: Architectural decision record

concepts.definition: One independent, project-owned HOW realisation of a product's WHAT, located by its product-definition tenant registry. One WHAT has one or more independent tenants regardless of layout. A tenant owns its binding, realisation and evidence; tenant-local truth remains derivative until ratified in specification.

grounding.quote:
A build tenant is one independent, project-owned HOW realisation of a
  product's WHAT.

concepts.label: Build tenant

concepts.definition: The product WHAT's obligations, permitted outcomes and rules for refining and composing realisation work.

grounding.quote:
The requirements calculus of a product is the set of obligations its
  WHAT states, the outcomes it permits, and its rules for refining and
  composing the work that realises it.

concepts.label: Requirements calculus

concepts.definition: A declared set of executable operations, composition laws, permitted transformations, effects and resource behaviour insofar as material to obligations.

grounding.quote: A computational calculus is a declared set of executable operations,

concepts.label: Computational calculus

concepts.definition: Concrete means performing operations: technology stack, human process of people/roles/documents/channels/decision procedures, or both. Author identity, actor identity and operation kind are distinct; operation kind combines what it does, such as construct/assess/relay/record/measure/decide, with required authority. A generic procedure has scope independent of the chosen environment.

grounding.quote:
An execution environment is the concrete means that performs those
  operations:

concepts.label: Execution environment and operation kinds

concepts.definition: Two-part tenant design relation: calculus binding from requirements calculus to computational calculus, and execution binding from computational calculus to concrete environment. The registry locates a tenant but is not its binding. Algorithmic, informational and computational accounts remain distinct across the binding.

grounding.quote: A tenant's build-tenant binding has two parts:

concepts.label: Build-tenant binding

concepts.definition: The subject's provenance ledger for predecessor rc.2 rows received locally or routed to tier-1/other members. Conserved rows are asserted to be restated at their receiving loci; routes are provenance only. It records generalisation of graph-specific wording, filenames, prefixes, overlay fields and profile shorthand; retained profile scope and modal force; proposed supersessions pending product-owner acceptance; newly authored distinctions; and receiving owners. Its entries are subject claims, not this interpretation's acceptance or fidelity findings.

grounding.quote:
Every conserved row is
restated in the receiving member's own text; a route is provenance only.

concepts.label: Source disposition ledger

concepts.definition: Tier-2 T-area standard owning the unified work-carrier model, layout/bindings, sprint/ticket rules, triage metadata and upward propagation, carrier selection and carrier-side execution admission, execution/verification separation, J/O continuity, closure/reuse, test-case authority, migration-ticket mechanics, one-truth projection, recommended shapes and operating mode. It realises FOUNDATIONS, ACTIVATION and EVALUATION rather than supplying foundational law; mechanisms may differ under the same principles.

grounding.quote: Tier 2. Owns the work carriers of the method:

concepts.label: TICKETS standard

concepts.definition: The current epic layer located by ticketing.goals, with GOALS.md the default file. Goals state active work wave and present priorities, broader than a ticket but narrower and more current than intent; they are not durable execution-tracking units.

grounding.quote:
Goals are
broader than one ticket, narrower and more current than the intent surface,

concepts.label: Ticketing goals

concepts.definition: One typed durable source-of-truth record per work unit, enduring across sessions; one Markdown file is the default carrier. Tickets are used where feature work, bugs, spikes or chores need independent durable identity, with bugs and features sharing one system.

grounding.quote: Tickets are the enduring work records. Each ticket is one durable record,

concepts.label: Ticket record

concepts.definition: TICKETS' bounded execution batch: one manifest under optional ticketing.sprints.root, default .ai-workspace/sprints/, batching authority references, closure law, evidence expectations and local deferred compliance. It closes through explicit sprint-close review, may contain durable tickets, manifest-local iterations or both, and holds batch authority without constitutional authority.

grounding.quote: Sprints are bounded execution batches.

concepts.label: Ticketing sprint

concepts.definition: A POSTING_GUIDE post on the board bound by ticketing.comments.root, default .ai-workspace/comments/, publishing ideas, strategy, reviews, handoffs, closure summaries and reasoned decisions. It has no task-status authority and no independent decision authority; a recorded decision obtains authority only by adoption on its owning surface.

grounding.quote: Comments are not task status authority.

concepts.label: Comment

concepts.definition: A run-scoped admitted work surface derived from a ticket, a sprint manifest plus included ticket/iteration, or intake drafting when no durable or sprint-local identity is needed. Unlike a ticket surviving sessions/work waves or a sprint surviving its batch and close review, it is the admitted execution function for one run; it is neither a rival backlog nor a second planning surface.

grounding.quote:
An execution contract is the run-scoped
admitted work surface

concepts.label: Execution contract

concepts.definition: A closure-bearing bounded work claim within a ticket, with stable identity, dependencies, current state, required evidence and explicit relation to ticket closure. Multiple milestones do not make multiple tickets.

grounding.quote:
A ticket may contain several closure-bearing milestones without becoming
several tickets.

concepts.label: Milestone and phase-scoped claim

concepts.definition: Starter layout: stdo_default.json; specification/GOALS.md; .ai-workspace/sprints/; .ai-workspace/tickets/{backlog,active,completed}/; and .ai-workspace/comments/<agent-id>/. This is a default carrier layout rather than a required physical structure.

grounding.quote: The starter file layout

concepts.label: Default ticketing layout

concepts.definition: Product-definition bindings locate epic goals (ticketing.goals), optional sprint batches/close review (ticketing.sprints.root), authoritative ticket lanes (ticketing.tickets.lanes.backlog, .active, .completed), and discussion/publication (ticketing.comments.root). The definition locates carriers without owning their ticket/comment content. A generated board is ordinarily a projection.

grounding.quote:
The definition locates these carriers and
does not own their ticket or comment content.

concepts.label: Ticketing bindings and board projections

concepts.definition: Substitution or extension of the valid default durable-local-file model by other bound carriers, generated boards, dependency checks, links to scenario/requirement/ADR surfaces, external tracker sync or standard-tool-protocol message integration, preserving authority and refusal laws.

grounding.quote: Another carrier is not required to reproduce its folders,

concepts.label: Carrier substitution

concepts.definition: One durable manifest record per sprint, defaulting to a Markdown file; another bound carrier retains its identity, required fields, history, closure law and one-truth relation. A stable id and short filename slug are recommended; SPRINT-2026-04-30-process-navigator.md and SPRINT-2026-05-12-dashboard-density.md are naming examples.

grounding.quote: Each sprint has one durable manifest record;

concepts.label: Durable sprint manifest

concepts.definition: Minimum sprint states: active admits iteration inside the boundary; closing freezes new iteration while close review/paydown classification run; closed means review finished and remaining debt accepted, ticketed, repriced or removed; superseded means an unsuitable boundary was replaced by a new authority surface, sprint or ticket set. Planned and cancelled are optional additions.

grounding.quote:
The minimum sprint status model is `active`, `closing`, `closed` and
`superseded`

concepts.label: Sprint status domain

concepts.definition: Batch-level admission under a reviewable manifest boundary, distinct from the universal intake and constitutional authority governing included work.

grounding.quote:
A sprint may admit work only when the manifest makes the boundary
reviewable.

concepts.label: Sprint admission

concepts.definition: Explicit sprint-held deferral of local compliance proof or cleanup, conditioned on local reviewable debt and favourable correction-versus-per-change-proof cost, with close-review classification and paydown. Escrow is not acceptance or silent debt.

grounding.quote:
Deferred compliance is not
silent debt: it is escrow held by the sprint,

concepts.label: Compliance escrow

conditions: A cited family consequence is applied by a consumer.

grounding.quote:
Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not (P2, P6).

constraints.statement: The family table accounts for §§4, 5 and 7 without adding decisions beyond cited owners. Its consequences require owner-only acceptance/re-entry, evidence-bearing diagnosis, recorded and applicability-checked classification, unknown preservation, conjunctive closure, bounded proof deferral, governed ambiguity, singular migration authority, shared-contract proof and explicit fundamental re-adoption. Domain choices remain attributed: six classes/four procedures and C/J/O/step order to this member; smallest sufficient frames to REFERENCE_FRAME §§5–6; sprint mechanics to TICKETS and domain escrow suitability to adopting profiles; ambiguity risk appetite to project policy and hard stops to ACTIVATION; re-adoption selection to the affected product boundary's human authority; strategies, path/adoption classes and inside-out order to this member.
constraints.uncertainty: The underlying foundations and several owning/consumer loci are outside the supplied source.

conditions: Any substantive intake arrives.

grounding.quote:
No bug, feature, issue or other intake bypasses this triage by going
straight to code, tests or release handling.

constraints.statement: Every substantive report uses the same triage regardless of label and receives all six determinations. No intake proceeds directly to code, tests or release handling. Supported repair routes to the owner of the diagnosed cause rather than a label-derived owner. TICKETS owns severity and priority policies; a bug list projects existing work state. The paragraph applies ACTIVATION's existing diagnosis relation rather than defining another.
constraints.uncertainty: The full impact-cover selection and severity/priority rules are referenced, not supplied.

conditions: Triage diagnoses a failure.

grounding.quote:
a frame planned and not applied
leaves its diagnosis open, never ruled out.

constraints.statement: Use the smallest sufficient applicable frame configuration over the same subject and basis. Each frame tests candidate diagnoses against its own material workspace variables, governing relations and evidence; combined results constrain supported causes, preserve unresolved alternatives/uncertainty and identify the smallest sufficient lawful repair scope. Each result retains its evaluated diagnosis predicate; any frame's counterexample survives conjunction; planned but unapplied frames leave diagnoses open. Renaming repeated analysis adds no evidence, and the exposing frame need not contain the cause. Apply counterexample localisation where required. No reviewer count or new review round is prescribed; required independence remains. Diagnosis grants neither repair effects nor proof that governing meaning must change; sufficient existing law may instead require candidate correction.
constraints.uncertainty: Frame applicability, conjunction and localisation mechanics remain externally referenced.

conditions: Substantive work begins or a changed governing relation is accepted.

grounding.quote:
The absence of a
declared change class is process drift.

constraints.statement: Re-entry below Goals requires an explicit assertion that no upstream constitutional surface changes. Every changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner, irrespective of delta size; acceptance merely inside the acting frame violates this rule. Record change intent, class, re-entry point and triage time wherever substantive work begins; record class on its carrier. realization_refactor must prove no upstream drift. Classes are declared states mapping to no core value and never combine as evaluation results. An evaluation of a class has its own predicate/core result; a layer-naming close classification is a result for its own predicate carrying re-entry class as domain outcome. A realization_refactor label cannot substitute for satisfied no-drift evidence.
constraints.uncertainty: Core-result and ticket close-classification mappings are not fully supplied.

conditions: A selected source, worksite or qualification capability produces C.

grounding.quote: The computed result exposes four things, in this order:

constraints.statement: Produce C over the exact request/outcome, known targets/effects, operation grant/lifetime, product definition/governing basis, baseline/available candidate, declared relations, accepted design/trace bindings, evidence and applicable rules. Output producer/procedure revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes, reproduction relation, unknowns and invalidators; missing candidate/evidence is an input state, not no-change evidence. In order: (1) follow explicit source/ownership/dependency/composition/projection declarations from targets/effects, recording reached layers/owners, exact bases, changed/unchanged/unknown relations, traversed edges and unresolved frontier; include root/authority/grant changes even with equal public bytes, and leave undeclared or uncertain materiality as J; (2) enumerate the complete relevant serialised member universe under owning declaration/projection, including helper/generated dependencies, additions/removals and every retained changed typed value/byte with exact before/after; (3) join changed bytes/relations to accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence, distinguishing covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside-scope, with semantic sufficiency left J; (4) apply only declared rules with sufficient facts, record owners/predicates/consequences, and expose smallest lawful re-entry, next action, evidence/assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime, leaving conflicts/missing premises unresolved. Absent edges do not prove irrelevance; filenames, artifact listings or digests do not prove accepted coverage or choose a route; no J is invented when rules settle the question.

exceptions: A rename preserves identity only if its owner supplies an identity-preserving relation.

grounding.quote:
Candidate
behaviour cannot author its own target law

constraints.statement: C/J/O annotations grant no authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface or mandatory document. Rename means removal plus addition absent the stated exception. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration, ambiguous identity or unavailable projection makes the affected delta unknown; equal membership proves no value equality. Classification facts map to no evaluation core value, unknown remains unknown when consumed, and covered/unchanged facts cannot substitute for satisfied. Nonconformance or public delta alone does not require a changed contract: if governing law remains sufficient, reject the candidate or repair locally within its grant. Re-enter the actual owner when the explicitly selected desired outcome requires changed meaning or applicable assessment establishes governing insufficiency. C establishes this only from sufficient declared premises; unresolved meaning/necessity is J and reserved decisions remain O.

conditions: Treatment, evidence or effect completion is unknown, or classification is reused or invalidated.

grounding.quote:
Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance or promotion, not unrelated
authorised work.

constraints.statement: Unknown treatment blocks dependent reliance/promotion only. An existing bounded construction/evidence grant may permit a cheapest useful discriminator, including a first candidate, with its own exact subject, territory, operations and stop conditions and no conformance assertion. Update affected C before dependent effects/promotion use new evidence. Correct a mistaken route at the smallest affected owner, preserving original cause, attempted subject, observed effect state and valid progress. Retry needs applicable outcome, authority and safe-recovery conditions. completion_unknown, or not_effected whose end is unestablished, is never silently no effect and must be reconciled under ACTIVATION §5 before retry/dependent action. New roles/conversations/resumptions reuse valid C only after exact-applicability checks. Changed request, candidate, owner/root relation, projection, design trace/acceptance, applied rule, configuration or material evidence invalidates affected C claims before reliance; changed basis and declared revising observation do likewise. Preserve predecessor/successor identities, changed inputs, surviving facts and affected J dependencies; recompute wider frontier where independence is unproved. TICKETS owns carrier and J/O continuity rules.
constraints.uncertainty: External recovery and J/O continuity procedures are not available in full.

conditions: A gate is considered for closure over a declared change span.

grounding.quote:
A
review event, a passing aggregate, a completed artifact or a status change
cannot substitute for that conjunction

constraints.statement: No affected active-surface inconsistency may remain. Prove upstream sufficiency, noncontradiction of active upstream truth by downstream artifacts, and tests/qualification of current intended behaviour rather than stale precedent; missing proof keeps the change open despite a correct-looking local artifact. Apply TICKETS §7's conjunction to all declared change-span obligations. Record by kind and block closure for a material mandatory-constraint counterexample, required judgment/ruling without closed result, or unaddressed obligation. Events, passing aggregates, completed artifacts and status changes do not replace the conjunction. Reuse follows ACTIVATION §7; TICKETS records work state. During ticketed code/test mismatch, implementation is evidence only; reconcile through the admitted ticket, triage, lawful re-entry and governing requirement/design/module/carrier/closure surface using externally owned test-authority rules.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete closure algebra and test-authority rules are externally owned.

conditions: A sprint is declared, iterated or closed.

grounding.quote: A lawful sprint states at least:

constraints.statement: Declare served goal/work wave, upstream authorities, admitted scope, excluded product/requirement/design/runtime/data-contract/governance boundaries, expected classes, any deferred local proof/compliance debt, closure trigger/law and close-discovered debt's paydown/repricing path. Deferral is lawful only while local, visible, bounded and repayable; escrow satisfies no method/release/product closure until paid down, explicitly accepted under governing method or repriced upstream. Close may be recommended when timebox expires, scope is reached, accumulated changes make review cheaper, uncertainty makes further work unsafe without reconciliation, or gaps outgrow the boundary; these are recommendations, not automatic close/approval. Close compares work/evidence with governing authority, classifies every gap, accepts compliant work, opens local paydown and escalates authority drift through lawful class. Discovered product-truth changes—including goals, intent, product, requirements, design, runtime, data contracts or governance—are not authorised to land by the manifest; split, escalate, reprice or carry explicit paydown. Profiles may define domain suitability of escrow.

conditions: Substantive work begins.

grounding.quote:
The triage fields are required wherever substantive work begins; a ticket
per change is not

constraints.statement: Select the carrier by required work lifetime; retain triage fields at every substantive start without requiring a ticket for every change.
constraints.uncertainty: The detailed smallest-lawful-carrier rule in TICKETS §5 is not supplied.

conditions: Substantive intake or feature introduction/change.

grounding.quote:
only then treat the work as implementation, repricing or
release-bound change.

constraints.statement: Before treating substantive intake as implementation/repricing/release work, triage, classify, identify lawful re-entry and the affected downstream consistency span. For feature work update goals if work wave/overriding concerns change, intent if purpose/scope changes, product if realisation/terms/boundaries/end-state changes; make invariant requirements explicit as product decomposition, including lifecycle obligations or named ambiguity gaps, and classify every new/changed requirement. Establish governing structural design. Where the design profile applies, co-evolution requires its predicate; otherwise accept the smallest causally closed affected design set before retained implementation establishes unresolved, contradictory or materially non-equivalent relations. Outside that profile, co-evolution is allowed only with no unresolved material design decision; otherwise accept affected design before retained implementation establishes it, with ADRs a valid form. Write operational-proof scenarios for relevant capability claims and other evidence for non-capability requirements where appropriate. Prefer declarative problem/acceptance expression before imperative mechanism. Check reconstruction support across goals→intent→product→requirements→design→implementation; record/govern major boundary ambiguity by declared risk appetite; develop under selected design and reconcile design/code/tests before promotion/closure; use events, projection and delta to test continued satisfaction.

conditions: Project bootstrap, requirement-surface repricing, or a real-use-case gap.

grounding.quote:
only after that surface
exists should downstream design and implementation be treated as
constitutionally grounded.

constraints.statement: For bootstrap/repricing: resolve product definition, verify exact installed basis, load declared bootstrap entrypoint then goals/bound work-wave carrier; perform goals-to-intent and intent-to-product, confirming their surfaces; gather relevant constitutional source and derive live requirements from product. Store individual files or grouped families to preserve clarity and avoid monolithic sprawl; make the requirement surface sole live authority before design/code, prefer declarative structure and record remaining major boundary ambiguity before downstream realisation. Only after that surface exists should design/implementation count as constitutionally grounded. For a real-use-case gap: first triage/classify, then write the scenario as the first substantive project artifact, analyse cause while retaining unseparated alternatives, re-enter the selected class's layer and flow forward. Write new goals/intent only for changed wave/direction/scope. Bug, feature, failed test, release blocker and operator sources do not change this sequence.
constraints.uncertainty: The bootstrap entrypoint contract and earlier constitutional derivation rules are not fully supplied.

conditions: A major boundary or declared ambiguity is encountered.

grounding.quote:
Ambiguity detection is
mandatory; blocking is policy

constraints.statement: Keep profile runtime shorthand in its own context absent explicit import/translation. Always surface/govern major ambiguity, never hide it in operator judgment, precedent or model choice. At every major boundary record remaining/new ambiguity, affected invariant/asset/decision boundary, decision if proceeding, and resolved/carried/escalated/blocked outcome. For the predicate that declared ambiguity is resolved on the exact basis, only resolved is satisfied; no dependent claim may treat other outcomes as resolution. Policy/risk appetite sets probabilistic carrying/decision versus admitted human adjudication, with ambiguity and decision recorded in either case; hard stops hold regardless. Relaying, recording or performing a step does not make a person an adjudicator; a person deciding under permissive policy without adjudication admission is governed by probabilistic-processing policy/recording. Work need not await elimination of all ambiguity, but ambiguity must be visible, governed and progressively constrained. An unanswered lifecycle phase is a recorded gap, never silent absence.
constraints.uncertainty: ACTIVATION's non-resolved core mappings and hard-stop classes are not enumerated in the supplied source.

grounding.quote:
a calculus, its interpretation of a subject and its carrier encoding keep
independent content identities, judgments, supersession relations and
proof obligations

constraints.statement: Use immutable release-cut identity for exact operative release selection. A cut is metadata/evaluation boundary over accepted features, not live project specification. Mutable version-line selectors are not exact dependency, evidence or constitutional bases and cannot silently change consumer selection. Shared realisation surfaces should describe current role/boundary/status rather than release-line labels. RELEASE owns criteria, publication, selector advancement, cutting and successor baseline conservation; PRODUCT_DEFINITION owns one constitutional surface/version boundary. Calculus, subject interpretation and carrier encoding retain independent identities, judgments, supersession and proof obligations; none is automatically an independently released Product.

conditions: A reusable method change or accompanying implementation is proposed.

grounding.quote: it requires its own Product authorisation

Other standards consume admitted law by reference. Consumers explicitly select a complete released STDO version, never mixed members from different cuts.

conditions: A change alters a load-bearing shared interface.

grounding.quote: change the authoritative core contract first;

constraints.statement: Handle the change as constitutional migration, not incremental local patching: change authoritative core first, prohibit bridge code as authoritative for its contract family, audit every producer and consumer, migrate each, and chase all downstream effects until no superseded closure law remains. Complete closure proof follows the completed wave; bounded slice proof retains its separate path-relative rule. Declaring completion while old/new producers split, runtime/reporting/topology use rival carriers, aliases stay authoritative, projections become second truth or tests mask split architecture is forbidden.

conditions: Selecting a strategy for core-interface or major implementation replacement.
exceptions: The bounded-evolution presumption does not require an unsafe or constitutionally inadmissible predecessor path or retention of mechanisms explicitly superseded by Product authority.

grounding.quote:
Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit selection by the human authority
owning the affected product boundary.

constraints.statement: Use inside-out hard breaks for in-place authoritative replacement on the same line; fundamental re-adoption applies to intentional major rederivation on materially different basis. When both are lawful/feasible and a working predecessor can reach the admitted outcome without competing/ambiguous authority, supported-path evolution is the rebuttable presumption conserving accepted semantics and feedback. Evolution involving core-interface migration uses hard breaks. Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit affected-boundary human-owner selection comparing product value, feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained semantics, and stating a bounded abort/re-entry condition. Scale or architectural preference alone cannot select it.

conditions: Either strategy promotes an affected outcome, defers residual material, or continues work after slice acceptance.
exceptions: Off-path residual material may be deferred only under all stated non-authority/disjoint-scope, claim-preservation and bounded-disposition conditions.

grounding.quote: Product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are distinct claims.

constraints.statement: No proxy partial implementation stands for the new contract on any acceptance path; no bridge/fallback remains silently authoritative. Promotion requires one unambiguous authority across the entire causal acceptance closure; admissibility of the same request/fact/identity/state/projection to old and new authority blocks promotion. Off-path superseded material may remain only if explicitly non-authoritative for the promoted outcome or governing explicitly specified disjoint product/compatibility scope with deterministic routing, unable to falsify current/retained claims, and assigned bounded migration/qualification/release disposition. Tests are proof/leak detectors, not migration plans. Intermediate promotion requires singular path authority and lawful residual deferral; it neither closes migration nor waives retirement. Slice identity/criteria derive from product plus all causally applicable live requirements, accepted design and retained predecessor claims; ticket/review wording cannot narrow these. Open migration does not renew exhausted slice-growth authority: admitted removal/demotion/closure-proof work may continue within its bound without claiming product progress; material producer/consumer growth needs another still-live §3 basis, not ticket activity alone.

conditions: Every core-interface migration.

grounding.quote: Every core interface migration explicitly declares:

constraints.statement: Declare exact affected scope; every excluded/disjoint product or compatibility scope and deterministic routing; new authoritative contract; superseded contract/surface; new authoritative closure law; full old/new producer and consumer sets; and every derived projection, report, status and proof surface. conditions: Core-interface migration.
exceptions: An explicit live-product compatibility feature whose path is intentionally specified, explicitly bounded and identified as compatibility rather than current native truth.

no bridge path participates in acceptance as if it were the new
contract;

conditions: Assessing migration completion.
constraints.statement: Migration remains incomplete if runtime/reporting/topology/proof can disagree on closure through different carriers or laws, if a projection can close independently while its authoritative carrier is open, or if the carrier can close while a projection depends on older law. conditions: Inside-out hard-break migration.
exceptions: Isolated non-authoritative downstream exploration may occur before source-carrier admission.

A
downstream projection ticket does not close while the source-carrier
ticket it depends on is still open.

conditions: Each break in an inside-out migration.
exceptions: Explicitly specified, deterministically routed non-overlapping product/compatibility scopes may coexist while migration remains open.
New affected interfaces leave the same wave only through explicit upward repricing.

run negative proof that the
severed seam is rejected rather than merely unused.

constraints.statement: Publish/admit the deepest new authoritative source carrier; deliberately sever one old authoritative seam and keep it severed; repair outward through consumers, projections, prompts/reports and proof surfaces; prove rejection rather than mere non-use. Tests may discover missing interfaces but cannot replace inventory; newly discovered affected interfaces remain in the wave unless explicitly repriced upward. Re-enabling the seam via wrappers, fallbacks, projections or prompts is a migration defect. The wave never licences competing/ambiguous authority over the same request, fact, identity, state or projection.

conditions: Proof is used for migration progress or closure.

grounding.quote:
Complete migration-closure proof is not valid while producers and
consumers are split across old and new contracts.

constraints.statement: Complete migration proof is invalid while producers/consumers split across contracts and belongs after migration. exceptions: A superseded path may remain for a justified distinct supported responsibility.

Until those conditions hold the
work remains an active migration wave, not a completed refactor

constraints.statement: Across declared scope, every authoritative producer writes and consumer reads the new contract; retire superseded authority except justified distinct responsibilities; projections derive from the same truth; runtime/reporting/topology/proof share one closure law; no temporary scaffolding remains in acceptance. Each retained mechanism identifies current obligation, owner, purpose, execution scope and material cost. Temporary compatibility/comparison needs expiry/removal trigger; tests, oracle labels or nominal demotion do not justify duplicate production responsibility. Identify surviving owners for surviving obligations; where no governing basis exists no replacement guard is required. Retirement within a closed affected cone need not await unrelated whole-product closure. Accepted slices name their closed scope and keep enclosing migration visibly open, without projecting acceptance as migration, qualification or release closure.

conditions: An intentional constitutional reset creates a new line.
constraints.statement: Declare migration line and treat old constitutional material as source, not live authority. Prior code/design governs only after rederivation and re-adoption; absence means not yet adopted, with no inherited authority. Move old implementation sideways if needed; classify every inherited module/interface/carrier/projection/proof surface before reuse, constitutional material as adopted/superseded/deferred/orphaned and implementation as carry_across/redundant/rewrite. Unclassified implementation is a defect. Copy only intentional retention and derive new design/code from new surfaces. carry_across is explicit adoption, not automatic copying. Direct runtime/projection/prompt/proof/review dependence on the sideways line is bridge debt; partial proxy imitation dependent on it is not lawful closure. New-surface creation is lawful supersession rather than silent mutation of the old surface.

conditions: Inherited requirements or other constitutional material are classified.
